newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM gold, platinum futures plunge by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM gold, platinum futures plunge by daily limit.

text.p: Most yen-based Tokyo gold and platinum futures tumbled in afternoon trade on Tuesday due to heavy long-liquidation after the yen's sharp rise against the dollar, traders said.
TOCOM June to April gold futures tumbled by their 40 yen per gram limit in the afternoon and benchmark April gold was down 40 yen at 1,235 yen at 0527 GMT.
The August to April platinum futures fell by their 50 yen per gram daily limit, with benchmark April platinum down by 50 yen at 1,348 yen.
"As the yen's rise has been too rapid, private investors are rushing to liquidate their longs. The market is swamped by sell orders," one trader said.
The dollar fell below 113 yen in afternoon Tokyo to its lowest level since December 13, 1996.
